## Description
Brief summary of the changes made and the problem being solved.

## Type of Change
- [ ] 🐛 Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] ✨ New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] 📝 Documentation update
- [ ] 🧪 Tests enhancement
- [ ] ⚡ Performance optimization

## Checklist
- [ ] My code follows the local-first, zero-overhead philosophy of `limit-upcoming`.
- [ ] I have added tests in `tests/` that prove my fix is effective or that my feature works.
- [ ] New and existing unit tests pass locally (`PYTHONPATH=src python -m unittest discover -s tests`).
- [ ] I have updated the relevant documentation (`docs/SPEC.md`, `README.md`, or `SKILL.md`) if applicable.
- [ ] Any new CLI options have been documented in `--help` and README.
